name: Caterpillar
description: Large diesel and natural-gas engine maker whose reciprocating gensets are sold for behind-the-meter prime power at data centres, up to about 10 MW per engine. It is expanding large-engine capacity at Lafayette, Indiana: a $725 million 2024 programme plus $890 million more, about $1.615 billion in total.
notes: cat.com product and newsroom pages timed out repeatedly on 2026-11-16; the capacity figures come from trade and investor coverage. The G3516 named in the January 2026 investor release is far below 10 MW - the 10 MW-class claim rests on Caterpillar's own commentary about reciprocating engines 'as large as 10 megawatts'.

sources.note: Large-engine capacity at 3x the 2024 level; engines up to 10 MW; behind-the-meter data centres, read 2026-11-16
Lafayette, Indiana: $890M on top of $725M = about $1.615bn, read 2026-11-16
